inspection.events_scope: recorded route, information, release, stage and service events through the selected frame; per-step movement audit records are excluded
inspection.claim_boundary: Frame state and event timestamps are recorded evidence. Whole-run totals and low-progress spans include the full run, including periods after this frame. Resource entrants are queue-entry history, not a reconstructed current queue or a per-resource individual wait. Trails use consecutive recorded positions, never interpolated movement or a measured path distance.
